articles.title: Carney appoints one of his top advisers and a Conservative MP to Senate
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney appointed Tom Pitfield, one of his senior advisers, and Conservative MP Richard Martel to the Senate, signalling a shift toward restoring partisan voices to the upper house.

articles.title: Carney hails submarine deal as NATO win, moves to ease South Korea's disappointment
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney celebrated Canada's submarine partnership with Germany and Norway at the NATO summit while meeting with South Korea's president to address their disappointment after losing the multibillion-dollar competition.
